correctness.rationale: Diagonalizing the cycle normalized Laplacian gives distinct low-pass lambda_k=1-cos(2*pi*k/N); each pair of conjugate Fourier eigenspaces has two-site 2x2 Gram eigenvalues (2/N)(1±|cos(2*pi*k*s/N)|), the constant block gives 2/N. This proves exactly the demixed frame constants (not those of raw trajectories). The map u=(2/g)s modulo M is surjective with fibers g; the K+1 cyclic residues 0,u,...,Ku have a gap <=q=floor(M/(K+1)), yielding min_{k<=K}||ku/M||<=q/M; u=q attains equality for all k. Divisibility forces equal gaps and generator u=aq (gcd(a,K+1)=1), giving g*phi(K+1) winning separations. Distinct eigenvalues make K+1 temporal Vandermonde powers invertible and 2K observations from K times insufficient in dimension 2K+1. Independently exhaustively tested ALL s for 1,558 (N,K) instances with 5<=N<=80, including all divisible equality counts; finite testing complements the all-integer pigeonhole proof.
residual_risks: These A/B bounds apply to spectrally demixed P_k outputs, NOT the raw Euclidean time-trajectory observations; temporal Vandermonde conditioning is separate.

final_claim: For C_N normalized Laplacian, H_K=span e_0,e_±1,...,e_±K, 1<=K<N/2, the per-eigenspace demixed two-site frame satisfies A_s=(2/N)(1-C_s), B_s=(2/N)(1+C_s), C_s=max_{1<=k<=K}|cos(2*pi*k*s/N)|. With M=N/gcd(N,2) and q=floor(M/(K+1)), maximum lower bound is (2/N)(1-cos(pi*q/M)) and minimum condition ratio cot²(pi*q/(2*M)); optimal offsets and, if divisible, their totient count are classified.
